members.name: create
members.doc:
Upload an MSA, declaring its ``format`` (e.g. ``"a3m"``, ``"fasta"``).

Parameters
----------
file : bytes | str
    The MSA contents; a ``str`` is encoded as UTF-8 (read a file first,
    e.g. ``open(path, "rb").read()``).
format : str
    The upload's format, naming the codec used to parse it.
name, description : str, optional
    Human-readable metadata to store alongside the MSA.
filename : str, optional
    Original filename to record; defaults to a name derived from ``format``.

Returns
-------
MSA
    The stored MSA.

members.name: sample_msa
members.doc:
Sample an alignment into prompt replicates.

Every option but ``msa`` and ``replicates`` is omitted when unset so
the sampling task's own default applies. Sampling stops at whichever of
``max_msa_sequences`` and ``max_msa_tokens`` is set; leave both unset
to take the default budget.

Parameters
----------
msa : str or MSA
    Stored alignment (``session.data.msa`` handle or its id) to sample,
    passed by id without downloading the alignment.
replicates : int, optional
    Number of prompts to sample, one per unit. Defaults to 1.
seed : int, optional
    Seed for the sampling. Each replicate draws its own from it. A
    missing seed is drawn client-side.
method : MSASamplingMethod, optional
    Sampling method.
homology_level : float, optional
    Level of homology for sequences in the MSA, between 0 and 1
    (neighbors methods only).
max_similarity : float, optional
    Maximum similarity between sequences in the MSA and the seed,
    between 0 and 1.
min_similarity : float, optional
    Minimum similarity between sequences in the MSA and the seed,
    between 0 and 1.
max_msa_sequences : int, optional
    Cap on the number of sequences sampled. Named
    ``num_sequences`` in ``MSAFuture.sample_prompt``.
max_msa_tokens : int, optional
    Cap on the number of residues sampled. Named
    ``num_residues`` in ``MSAFuture.sample_prompt``.
force_include_first : bool, optional
    Whether to always include the seed sequence.

Returns
-------
PromptFuture
    Handle on the submitted sampling job, whose id is the prompt id.
    ``future.get()`` returns every replicate's complex sequences once
    ready.

Raises
------
MissingParameterError
    If both ``max_msa_sequences`` and ``max_msa_tokens`` are given.
APIError
    If there is an issue with the API request.
